facts.fact: Analyst Meryem Aanaiber writes in Telquel that Penal Code Articles 447-1 to 447-3 (added by Law No. 103-13 of 2018) are the most directly applicable legal basis against deepfakes, with penalties of one to three years' imprisonment for 447-2, though no law defines deepfakes.
Telquel's op-ed says a 17-article bill under discussion in the House of Representatives would provide specific penalties for deepfake abuses and digital manipulation.

MAR.note: Document states nothing on this question for Morocco.
